messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "ask doctor about bone density scan or calcium and vitamin D supplement"
set: ["ask doctor about bone density scan or calcium and vitamin D supplement", "learn about foods to eat for enough calcium and vitamin D in diet", "includes dietary changes and taking calcium and vitamin supplements", "ask your doctor about any risk", "ask doctor about taking medicine if pregnant", "ask about potassium intake specifically", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting", "ask your doctor about using a non-hormonal birth control", "ask doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting and at regular intervals afterwards", "ask doctor before stopping", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening at regular intervals", "consult doctor or pharmacist about safety", "ask your doctor or pharmacist for more information", "ask doctor before taking NSAID", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "ask doctor before changing dose or medication schedule"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
